title: Sprint 4 — Task Updates, Deletions, and Filtering
description: Implement task modifications, completion toggles, deletions, and status query parameter filtering.

tickets.title: Ticket 1 - Update Task & Status Toggle API
tickets.description:
Build `PUT` and `PATCH /api/tasks/{id}` to allow updating a task's title, description, or completion status (`is_completed`).

### Request Header
`Authorization: Bearer <jwt_token>`

### Request Body (Partial or Full)
```json
{
  "title": "Updated Title",
  "is_completed": true
}
```

### Requirements
1. Protect endpoint with Spring Security authentication.
2. Verify the task belongs to `currentUser`. Return `404 Not Found` if missing or unauthorized.
3. Update fields if provided in request body. If `title` is provided, validate it is not empty. Return `400 Bad Request` if empty.
4. Save updated task and return `200 OK` with `{"message": "Task updated successfully", "task": task.toDict()}`.
learning_objectives: Support partial and full REST resource updates in Spring Boot.
Persist updated entity state with JPA.

tasks.title: Return HTTP 200 with updated task payload.

common_mistakes: Allowing empty string titles to overwrite valid titles.
Modifying tasks of other users without ownership verification.

tickets.title: Ticket 2 - Delete Task API
tickets.description:
Build `DELETE /api/tasks/{id}` to allow users to permanently delete a task.

### Request Header
`Authorization: Bearer <jwt_token>`

### Requirements
1. Protect endpoint with Spring Security authentication.
2. Verify the task belongs to `currentUser`. Return `404 Not Found` if missing or unauthorized.
3. Delete the task record using `taskRepository.delete(task)`.
4. Return `200 OK` with `{"message": "Task deleted successfully"}`.
learning_objectives: Implement resource deletion in REST APIs with Spring Boot.
Enforce horizontal authorization on DELETE requests.
Handle database deletion operations in Spring Data JPA.

tasks.title: Enforce ownership authorization on task deletion.
Delete task from database using repository delete and return 200.

common_mistakes: Deleting another user's task without ownership validation.
Throwing unhandled exceptions on non-existent IDs instead of 404.
hints: `taskRepository.delete(task)` followed by returning HTTP 200 with message.

tickets.title: Ticket 3 - Task Filtering by Status Query Parameter
tickets.description:
Enhance `GET /api/tasks` to support query parameter filtering by completion status: `?completed=true` or `?completed=false`.

### Requirements
1. If `?completed=true` is passed in URL query string, return only tasks where `is_completed == true`.
2. If `?completed=false` is passed, return only tasks where `is_completed == false`.
3. If `completed` parameter is omitted or empty, return all tasks for the current user as before.
4. All tasks must still strictly belong to `currentUser`.
learning_objectives: Read and parse optional URL query parameters using `@RequestParam(required = false)`.
Apply conditional JPA repository filtering based on request parameters.
Combine user authorization with custom filtering conditions.

tasks.title: Apply dynamic filtering based on parameter value while maintaining user isolation.
Return filtered tasks list with HTTP 200.

common_mistakes: Treating string parameter as primitive boolean without handling null when omitted.
Overriding user ownership filter when applying status filter.
hints: If `completed != null && !completed.trim().isEmpty()`, parse boolean and call `findByUserIdAndIsCompletedOrderByCreatedAtDesc`.
